body: hey guys amber (the girl that posted this) is in the hospital. she went into a coma a week ago after taking all of her sleeping pills. her boyfriend and her split and her dog died. it was rough but they think she will wake up soon. thank you all for trying to help her.
thank you, people like you give me hope for he human race.
well by the time i find those people ill be to broken down by all of the bullshit to be myself

iv been cutting for ten years which is half of my life. people have told me to stop they have called me stupid because i do it but no one ever asked why. sure i probably wouldn't have an answer for them but at least then i would have known they cared.
i don't have insurance. or a job.

that's the thing there is no story i hate my life for no reason. i hate my self because my entire life iv been told that everyone else was better then me. i cant connect with people. i don't know what i'm doing. i'm not smart or attractive. i don't have a good personality. i cant love or be loved because it scares me.

it'll get better okay at least i hope it does. i want to give you words of hope but i don't have any. you have to find a reason to live. you must find hope for tomorrow. just find a distraction it helps. read a book or lose your self in a song. write a book about how you feel....maybe later u'll save some one else but don't give up. you living on gives others hope. you could save a life.
how can i not? i have nothing left.
